notes: Proxy-tier-only expansion (issue #871): 2 Hope singleton dwarf ground slots plus 14 pack generators (count 2-3, unprotected, Hope/Spring day-2/5/16 renewable ground). Pack binding proven by launch probe pk1 (2026-09-21, native claude/p2-proxy-family at ba6832cef, product sampler, Forest of Hope + Distant Spring day 2): all 8 live packs bound every member (P2_BATCH2_BIND lines per species == pack count), no P2_SETUP_SKIP, no duplicate-generator abort; logs output/claude-orch/evidence/packs-forest and packs-spring. The 6 day-5/day-16 packs share the native path but were not live in that probe. P2_PLACEMENT_SLOT markers showed terrain=ground route=1 for every probed member, yet pack terrain/route stays 'unprobed' here because nothing folded them through scripts/audit_p2_placement_evidence.py. The 2 Hope singletons (1849273021, 2049888785) are SHARED with docs/PIKMIN2_ADMITTED_PLACEMENT.json since placement-cap (#871): proxy_only is false and terrain/route are true, backed by two native P2_PLACEMENT_SLOT probes that agree (terrain=ground route=1): pk1 (proxy hosts 16/4, evidence/packs-forest/native.log L789/L801, route_distance 96.3/187.8) and the six-gate rev8 run (Frog/Wtank, native eb510ff4, route_distance 93.1/187.2; native route coverage radius is 200). The probe samples terrain and nearest waypoint at the slot XYZ, so the capability is a property of the slot, not of the tier. Six-gate species never use the 14 pack slots. No committed slot is reserved from proxies: a proxy keeps its Pikmin 1 host Pikmin 1 behaviour and corpse.
